topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: Adaptive beamforming strategies, exploiting the dominant LOS path and mitigating Rician fading effects, ensure consistent LOS connectivity. Spatial multiplexing techniques enhance capacity, while adaptive modulation and coding schemes optimize capacity gain and minimize interference. Phased array architectures and hybrid analog-digital beamforming approaches can further optimize performance.
reference_context: A2A communications face challenges due to high velocity, frequency selective fading, and Rician distributed fading, requiring advanced beamforming strategies for stable connectivity.
